# Recreation Prompt

Build **Capsule Rizz Run**, a portrait-first browser-native endless runner. Preserve the source truth: the player controls a vehicle near the bottom of a vertically scrolling road by dragging one thumb horizontally; obstacles spawn from the top in lanes; speed ramps over time; score increases by distance and successful overtakes; collision ends the run and shows final score plus restart.

Reinterpret the world as a satirical cyber-y2k shonen chase inspired by red capsule-bike anime energy without copying protected characters. The player is a red capsule superbike rider keeping a friends-session stream alive. Rival bots, ad vans, and algorithm blockers are the hazards. Score is **Clout Route**, speed is **Hype**, overtakes trigger **W Rizz** / **Era Bonus** feedback, and failure is **Clip Ended**.

Use a single self-contained `index.html` with inline CSS and JavaScript, Canvas for gameplay, DOM for HUD and modals, approved catalog fonts/audio/GIFs only, and mobile-safe touch handling. The result should look authored from screenshots: neon grid expressway, manga speed fins, cyberpunk billboards, meme tags, strong red capsule bike focal silhouette, readable HUD, and clear one-thumb onboarding.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
The preserved source is a mobile-friendly canvas endless runner. The player controls a vehicle near the bottom of the screen by dragging horizontally across a four-lane road. The game auto-scrolls forward, accelerates over time, spawns traffic from the top, checks forgiving AABB collisions, increases score by distance/speed, awards a fixed overtake bonus when hazards pass off-screen, and ends only on collision. Start and restart buttons wrap the same loop.

## Protected Mechanics
- Endless runner loop with no win state.
- One-thumb drag/pointer horizontal movement mapped to road X.
- Four-lane road geometry, centered road width, and lane-based traffic spawn.
- Gradual speed increase and spawn cadence tied to speed.
- Distance score plus successful-overtake bonus.
- Collision failure with particles, final score, and restart.

## Remix Target
**Capsule Rizz Run** reinterprets the same runner as a satirical cyber-y2k shonen bike chase through a Neo-Tokyo meme expressway. The avatar is a red capsule superbike carrying the squad stream. Hazards are algorithm blockers, rival bots, and ad vans. Score is clout route; speed is hype. Overtakes are W-rizz clips.

## Safe Transform Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, start/game-over copy, procedural drawing, background city/grid, particles, feedback overlays, fonts, catalog audio, and state flavor are safe because they do not alter input, collision, score, speed, spawning, or restart semantics.
